name: Pac-Man
desc: A playable classic-style Pac-Man arcade in vanilla JS: eat the pellets, outmaneuver the chasers, grab power pellets, and clear the maze level after level — every sprite drawn in code.
controls: Arrow keys or WASD to move, Enter/Space to start, P to pause, M to mute (touch + swipe supported)
creator: hammadshakeelai
